title: The five o'clock fight
idealUser: A UK parent of an eight year old. The tablet handover at five o'clock turns into a row that ruins the evening.

beats.headline: Two more minutes becomes twenty.
beats.sub: Then it is a row, and the row is about the tablet but it ruins the evening.

beats.headline: Nine in ten parents have this fight.
beats.sub: You are not doing it wrong. Nobody gave you a plan.

beats.headline: The screen was never the prize.
beats.sub: A small core of time is theirs, no strings. The rest is earned.

beats.headline: Jobs pay stars. Stars buy minutes.
beats.sub: The child pitches a job. You say yes. A timer runs where you can both see it.

beats.headline: The deal does the arguing.
beats.sub: When the countdown ends, a deal ran out. You did not.
